name: Emergency Response Support System (ERSS)
description: India's emergency response number for immediate police, fire, medical, and other emergencies.
availability_note: ERSS describes 112 as a pan-India emergency number. Check its official page for current access details.
accessibility_options: The ERSS page lists phone, SMS, email, web request, panic-button, and mobile-app options.

name: Women Helpline
description: Women Helpline for assistance and information; the Ministry reports it is operational in all States/UTs except West Bengal.
availability_note: The Ministry of Women and Child Development says 181 is operational in all States/UTs except West Bengal. Availability for an unrecorded state must be checked.
accessibility_options: Use the official Ministry page to check state coverage and available support options. For an immediate emergency in India, see the separate ERSS 112 listing if you choose.

name: Child Helpline
description: Child Helpline under Mission Vatsalya, coordinated with State and District functionaries and integrated with ERSS-112.
accessibility_options: The Ministry lists Child Help Desks/Kiosks/Booths at selected railway stations and bus stands, and round-the-clock district Child Helpline units.

name: National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal
description: Government of India portal for cybercrime reports. The 1930 helpline is specifically for online financial cyber fraud; use the portal for other cybercrime reporting options.
availability_note: The official portal identifies 1930 for online financial fraud. This registry does not verify response times or outcomes.
accessibility_options: For cybercrime other than online financial fraud, use the official portal's online reporting options.

name: National Legal Services Authority (NALSA)
description: NALSA lists 15100 for legal aid, advice, and assistance. Eligibility and the appropriate legal services institution depend on applicable rules and territorial and subject-matter jurisdiction.
availability_note: The official NALSA page lists toll-free helpline 15100; current call availability is not separately stated on that page.
accessibility_options: The NALSA page also lists National, State, District, Taluka, High Court, and Supreme Court legal services institutions.

name: SHe-Box
description: Ministry of Women and Child Development portal for complaints about sexual harassment at work.
availability_note: The Ministry currently links to SHe-Box from its official website and describes the portal as live. Review its instructions before filing.
accessibility_options: The official Ministry page links to SHe-Box and provides Ministry contact details if the portal cannot be used.

name: Centralized Public Grievance Redress and Monitoring System (CPGRAMS)
description: Government of India public-authority grievance portal for service-delivery matters, connected to Union ministries/departments and States; exclusions apply.

name: National Consumer Helpline (NCH)
description: Department of Consumer Affairs helpline and portal for consumer grievances about goods and services. It is a pre-litigation support path and does not guarantee a remedy.
availability_note: The official contact page lists 1915 and 1800-11-4000 daily from 8:00 a.m. to 8:00 p.m., except national holidays.
accessibility_options: The official site also lists web registration, WhatsApp, SMS, the NCH app, and UMANG. Check the site for current access details.
